categories_thin: Property management: nearly every firm marketing 'South Brunswick property management' is based elsewhere (New Brunswick, Hamilton, Trenton, East Brunswick). In-township candidates are small: Kent Management, Varma Properties, 11 Commerce Court LLC, Tverdov Housing.
Land surveying: only William M. Doran & Sons is confirmed in-township; other surveyors found are in New Brunswick, Piscataway, Sayreville and Matawan.

Environmental consulting: only three in-township names surfaced (Panther Technologies, Hydros, Hesa) plus two engineering firms doing the work; the township's own 2026 appointments are all out-of-town firms.

Architecture and engineering skew heavily to small home-office practices and to firms with a Monmouth Junction mailing address but no published street address, so many entries carry 'Unknown' addresses.
Banks, hospitals and large firms were deliberately not swept, which also removes several advisory offices co-located inside them.
caveats: Chain/franchise-branded entries (Allstate and Farmers agents, Century 21, RE/MAX, Better Homes & Gardens, Weichert, Edward Jones, J.P. Morgan, Altran, Criterium, Allegra, Jack Morton) are included for completeness but likely fall under the exclusion rule - triage should decide.
Many entries come from bulk directories (D&B, WhereOrg, AllBiz, AllPages, necomps, Cylex, Hubbiz) with no independent confirmation; these are marked 'one directory only'.
Several law and accounting listings are individuals' names at residential streets (Kendall Park and Dayton cul-de-sacs); these are likely solo practitioners or home offices rather than firms.
Some addresses sit on roads crossing the East Brunswick/South Brunswick line (Cranbury Rd, Ryders Ln, Georges Rd, US-130) - town attribution should be confirmed before outreach.
Nine entries carry 'Unknown' addresses because only name/rating metadata was available; these are the weakest records in the file.

A handful of duplicate-looking clusters need merging at triage: Pavese-McCormick / King Risk Partners; Providence Abstract / Alternative Abstract; Rajan & Rajan / Rajan Legal PC; Johnson Jones Architects / George E. Jones AIA; Marc D. Binder CPA / Binder Tobin CPAs; CSI Group / Master Tax Inc.
data_gaps: Yellow Pages, BBB, Manta, Yelp, ChamberofCommerce.com, SuperPages, Cylex, AllBiz, AllPages, WhereOrg, D&B, Hub.biz, Manta, Loc8NearMe and LocalityBiz all returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches from this network; content was reachable only as search-engine snippets and cached mirrors, so page-level verification was not possible.
Google Maps served a 'limited view' of roughly 11 results per query with no pagination or full map browse; Google web search returned a bot-detection interstitial.
Overpass/OpenStreetMap API returned HTTP 406 on GET and timed out on POST, so no OSM cross-check was possible.
Exa search hit its free rate limit partway through, truncating some category sweeps (notably property management and surveying).
No township or county licensed-business list for South Brunswick was found; the South Brunswick Economic Development Committee site is a newsletter site, not a directory.
Pages requiring sign-in (LinkedIn profiles behind auth, ZoomInfo, PitchBook) were skipped, so headcount and revenue figures are limited to what public company pages showed.
